title: Austin Budget Talk & Unfilled Committee Posts
summary:
*   City officials held a special "retreat" meeting to discuss the upcoming budget, develop a workplan, and review various special projects.
*   The meeting took place off-site at a local fitness center, signaling a less formal, focused session.
*   A proposed resolution concerning appointments to the crucial Policy Planning and Budget Committee and the Audit Committee was not approved or even discussed.
